 Aggrieved by the order in C.C.No.11/2009 on the file
of District Forum-II, Tirupathi, opposite
parties preferred this appeal.
The brief facts as set out in the complaint are
that the complainant purchased a mobile of Sony Ericson model No.K320 bearing
IME No.353322013470597 with battery No.146758SWLGNM07WOs and charger on
13-5-2007 under bill No.2907 for an amount of Rs.5,100/- from the second
opposite party, which is the branch office of 1st opposite party. It is the case of the complainant that from
the date of purchase the mobile is giving trouble as the battery is not working
property and when he complained the same to opposite party No.2 and asked for
replacement of the mobile or refund of the cost of the mobile as it is within
warranty period, opposite party No.2 has not given any response. When the complainant demanded opposite party
No.2 to replace the same, he replied in a rash manner. The complainant also complained to opposite
party No.1 but there was no response. The
complainant got issued a legal notice dated 25-3-2008 calling upon the opposite
parties to replace the mobile with a new one or in the alternative pay the cost
of the mobile along with interest but there was no response. Hence the complaint for a direction to the
opposite parties to jointly and severally replace the mobile phone or pay the
cost of the piece along with interest at 18% p.a. from the date of its purchase
i.e. 13-5-2007 till the date of realization together with compensation of
Rs.50,000/- and costs of Rs.5,000/-.
The second opposite party resisted the complaint
denying the averments made in the complaint.
It admitted the purchase of the mobile phone by the complainant and
submitted that they are not manufacturers of the said mobile and that various
mobiles are exhibited in their show room.
When the customer purchases a mobile piece, the warrantee/guarantee, if
any, is given by the respective companies only and in case of any complaint
regarding the sold mobile is received, they will extend the service by
endorsing the said complaint to various service centres to safe guard the
interest of the customer. The complainant
made a complaint regarding the mobile on 29-3-2008 after a period of 11
months. The second opposite party
submitted that it prepared a job sheet on 29-3-2008 and forwarded it to the authorized service centre of Sony Ericson
i.e. Siri Communications, Khairatabad, Hyderabad and it replied to the said job
sheet that Warrant not claimed and water locked and that the said defect was
not covered under the warranty and returned the same to second opposite party. Subsequently, the second opposite party
intimated the complainant the said fact and he came to the showroom and on
knowing the said fact took his mobile and requested opposite party No.2 to provide a new piece
for which it expressed its inability. Opposite
party No.2 submitted that there is no deficiency in service on its part and
that the complaint is not maintainable because of non jointer of proper parties
and prayed for dismissal of the complaint with costs.
Based on the evidence adduced i.e. Exs.A1 to A6 and
B1 and the pleadings put forward, the District Forum allowed the complaint in
part directing the opposite parties to replace the mobile phone with a new one
and pay Rs.1500/- towards costs.
Aggrieved by the said order, the opposite parties
preferred this appeal.
The respondent/complainant filed his written
arguments.
The facts not in dispute are that the complainant
purchased a Sony Ericsson mobile phone evidenced under Ex.A1 from opposite party
No.2 on 13-5-2007 for an amount of Rs.5,100/-. It is the complainants case
that the said mobile is giving trouble as the battery is not giving much stand
by time and the same was complained to opposite party No.2 but there was no
response. He also got issued a legal notice evidenced under Ex.A2 dated
25-03-2008 to opposite parties 1 and 2 seeking refund or replacement of the
mobile phone. Ex.B1 is the job work sheet given by opposite party No.2 for the
nature of complaint as Battery connector,
I.C. Problem. It is the appellants case that they are only dealers and that as
per the terms and conditions of warranty, the appellants are not entitled to
open the cell phone to rectify any problem and only the authorized service
centre has to check and rectify the problems. In fact on a complaint by the
respondent/complainant, a job sheet was prepared and the mobile phone was at
their own cost sent to the authorized service centre i.e. Siri Communications,
Khairatabad and the said service centre opined that the mobile phone was water
locked and therefore the warranty cannot be claimed. After receipt of the
legal notice dated 25-03-2008, the appellants prepared the job card on
29-03-2008 when the complainant approached opposite party No.2 and deposited
the same.
We
observe from the record that the mobile phone was purchased on 13-05-2007 and
before one month of expiry of warranty i.e. on 25-3-2008 the complainant
approached the opposite party and on 29-3-2008 deposited the mobile phone with
opposite party No.2. The main contention of the opposite party No.2 is that the
mobile is water locked and hence not covered under warranty. In fact, Ex.B1 job
sheet given by opposite party No.2 on 29-03-2008 states that the nature of
complaint is battery connector, IC problem, no where have they stated in the
nature of complaint that the problem is because of water locking and not
covered under warranty. Taking into consideration that the cell phone was
purchased on 13-05-2007 and used for 11 months, the order of the District Forum
in directing the appellants to replace the mobile phone, in these days of
changing models, is unsustainable and we modify the order of the District Forum
directing the appellants to pay compensation of Rs.3,000/- instead of replacing
the mobile phone keeping in view the 11 months period during which the
complainant has used the said phone while we confirm the costs of Rs.1500/-
awarded by the District Forum.
In the
result the appeal is allowed in part and the order of the District Forum is modified
directing the appellants to pay an amount of Rs.3,000/- towards compensation
for the mobile phone which is lying with the appellants instead of replacing
the mobile, in these days of changing models, while confirming the costs of
Rs.1500/- awarded by the District Forum. Time for compliance four weeks.
